    21→type swapRequest struct {
    22→	model  string
    23→	doneCh chan error
    24→}

    26→type procState struct {
    27→	mu      sync.Mutex
    28→	backend config.Backend
    29→	port    int
    30→	proc    *os.Process
    31→	healthy bool
    32→	swapCh  chan swapRequest
    33→}
    34→
    35→// Manager supervises llama-server child processes for managed backends and
    36→// health-checks external backends.
    37→type Manager struct {
    38→	cfg        *config.Config
    39→	log        *slog.Logger
    40→	cmdBuilder func(ctx context.Context, b config.Backend, port int) *exec.Cmd
    41→
    42→	mu     sync.RWMutex
    43→	procs  map[string]*procState
    44→	wg     sync.WaitGroup
    45→	cancel context.CancelFunc
    46→}
    47→
    48→// New creates a Manager. It does not start any processes; call Start.
    49→func New(cfg *config.Config, log *slog.Logger) *Manager {
    50→	m := new(Manager)
    51→	m.cfg = cfg
    52→	m.log = log
    53→	m.procs = make(map[string]*procState)
    54→	m.cmdBuilder = func(ctx context.Context, b config.Backend, port int) *exec.Cmd {
    55→		return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "llama-server", buildArgs(b, port)...)
    56→	}
    57→	return m
    58→}
    59→
    60→// Start launches supervisor goroutines for all managed backends.
    61→// It returns immediately; health checks happen asynchronously.
    62→func (m *Manager) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
    63→	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
    64→	m.cancel = cancel
    65→
    66→	for name, b := range m.cfg.Backends {
    67→		if !b.IsManaged() {
    68→			continue
    69→		}
    70→		ps := new(procState)
    71→		ps.backend = b
    72→		ps.swapCh = make(chan swapRequest, 1)
    73→
    74→		m.mu.Lock()
    75→		m.procs[name] = ps
    76→		m.mu.Unlock()
    77→
    78→		m.wg.Add(1)
    79→		go m.supervise(ctx, name)
    80→	}
    81→	return nil
    82→}
    83→
    84→// Stop cancels all managed processes and waits for them to exit.
    85→func (m *Manager) Stop() error {
    86→	if m.cancel != nil {
    87→		m.cancel()
    88→	}
    89→	m.wg.Wait()
    90→	return nil
    91→}
    92→
    93→// Healthy reports whether a backend is ready to serve requests.
    94→// For external backends it performs a best-effort GET /health.
    95→func (m *Manager) Healthy(name string) bool {
    96→	m.mu.RLock()
    97→	ps, ok := m.procs[name]
    98→	m.mu.RUnlock()
    99→
   100→	if ok {
   101→		ps.mu.Lock()
   102→		defer ps.mu.Unlock()
   103→		return ps.healthy
   104→	}
   105→
   106→	b, ok := m.cfg.Backends[name]
   107→	if !ok || !b.IsExternal() {
   108→		return false
   109→	}
   110→
   111→	resp, err := http.Get(b.URL + "/health") //nolint:noctx
   112→	if err != nil {
   113→		// Best-effort: some external APIs don't implement /health.
   114→		return true
   115→	}
   116→	defer resp.Body.Close()
   117→	return resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK
   118→}

   120→// Addr returns the base URL for a backend.
   121→// For managed backends it returns "http://localhost:<port>".
   122→// For external backends it returns Backend.URL.
   123→func (m *Manager) Addr(name string) (string, bool) {
   124→	m.mu.RLock()
   125→	ps, ok := m.procs[name]
   126→	m.mu.RUnlock()
   127→
   128→	if ok {
   129→		ps.mu.Lock()
   130→		defer ps.mu.Unlock()
   131→		if ps.port == 0 {
   132→			return "", false
   133→		}
   134→		return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", ps.port), true
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	b, ok := m.cfg.Backends[name]

   139→		return "", false

   141→	return b.URL, true

   144→// Swap hot-swaps the model for a managed backend.
   145→// It stops the running process, updates the model, starts a new process, and
   146→// waits up to 120 seconds for the health check to pass.
   147→func (m *Manager) Swap(ctx context.Context, name, model string) error {
   148→	m.mu.RLock()
   149→	ps, ok := m.procs[name]
   150→	m.mu.RUnlock()
   151→
   152→	if !ok {
   153→		return fmt.Errorf("backend %q is not a managed backend", name)
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	doneCh := make(chan error, 1)
   157→	select {
   158→	case ps.swapCh <- swapRequest{model: model, doneCh: doneCh}:
   159→	case <-ctx.Done():
   160→		return ctx.Err()
   161→	}
   162→
   163→	select {
   164→	case err := <-doneCh:
   165→		return err
   166→	case <-ctx.Done():
   167→		return ctx.Err()
   168→	}
   169→}

   171→// supervise is the per-backend restart loop. It runs until ctx is cancelled
   172→// or max retries are exceeded.
   173→func (m *Manager) supervise(ctx context.Context, name string) {
   174→	defer m.wg.Done()
   175→
   176→	m.mu.RLock()
   177→	ps := m.procs[name]
   178→	m.mu.RUnlock()
   179→
   180→	defer func() {
   181→		ps.mu.Lock()
   182→		ps.healthy = false
   183→		ps.proc = nil
   184→		ps.mu.Unlock()
   185→	}()
   186→
   187→	const (
   188→		maxRetries  = 5
   189→		retryWindow = 60 * time.Second
   190→		backoff     = 2 * time.Second
   191→	)
   192→
   193→	var (
   194→		attempts    int
   195→		windowStart = time.Now()
   196→	)
   197→
   198→	for {
   199→		select {
   200→		case <-ctx.Done():
   201→			return
   202→		default:
   203→		}
   204→
   205→		// Reset the retry counter when the window has elapsed.
   206→		if time.Since(windowStart) > retryWindow {
   207→			attempts = 0
   208→			windowStart = time.Now()
   209→		}
   210→
   211→		if attempts >= maxRetries {
   212→			m.log.Error("max restart retries exceeded, giving up", "backend", name)
   213→			return
   214→		}
   215→
   216→		if attempts > 0 {
   217→			m.log.Info("restarting backend", "backend", name, "attempt", attempts)
   218→			select {
   219→			case <-ctx.Done():
   220→				return
   221→			case <-time.After(backoff):
   222→			}
   223→		}
   224→
   225→		attempts++
   226→
   227→		port, err := freePort()
   228→		if err != nil {
   229→			m.log.Error("port allocation failed", "backend", name, "error", err)
   230→			continue
   231→		}
   232→
   233→		ps.mu.Lock()
   234→		ps.port = port
   235→		ps.healthy = false
   236→		backend := ps.backend
   237→		ps.mu.Unlock()
   238→
   239→		cmd, err := m.launch(ctx, name, backend, port)
   240→		if err != nil {
   241→			m.log.Error("failed to launch llama-server", "backend", name, "error", err)
   242→			continue
   243→		}
   244→
   245→		ps.mu.Lock()
   246→		ps.proc = cmd.Process
   247→		ps.mu.Unlock()
   248→
   249→		if err := waitHealthy(ctx, port, 120*time.Second); err != nil {
   250→			m.log.Error("health check failed on start", "backend", name, "error", err)
   251→			cmd.Process.Kill()
   252→			cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
   253→			ps.mu.Lock()
   254→			ps.proc = nil
   255→			ps.mu.Unlock()
   256→			continue
   257→		}
   258→
   259→		ps.mu.Lock()
   260→		ps.healthy = true
   261→		ps.mu.Unlock()
   262→		m.log.Info("backend healthy", "backend", name, "port", port)
   263→
   264→		exitCh := make(chan error, 1)
   265→		go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
   266→
   267→	monitor:
   268→		for {
   269→			select {
   270→			case <-ctx.Done():
   271→				// cmd.Cancel sends SIGTERM; cmd.WaitDelay gives 10s then SIGKILL.
   272→				<-exitCh
   273→				return
   274→
   275→			case req := <-ps.swapCh:
   276→				ps.mu.Lock()
   277→				ps.healthy = false
   278→				ps.backend.Model = req.model
   279→				backend = ps.backend
   280→				ps.mu.Unlock()
   281→
   282→				cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM) //nolint:errcheck
   283→				select {
   284→				case <-exitCh:
   285→				case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
   286→					cmd.Process.Kill() //nolint:errcheck
   287→					<-exitCh
   288→				}
   289→
   290→				ps.mu.Lock()
   291→				ps.proc = nil
   292→				ps.mu.Unlock()
   293→
   294→				newPort, portErr := freePort()
   295→				if portErr != nil {
   296→					req.doneCh <- portErr
   297→					break monitor
   298→				}
   299→
   300→				ps.mu.Lock()
   301→				ps.port = newPort
   302→				ps.mu.Unlock()
   303→
   304→				newCmd, launchErr := m.launch(ctx, name, backend, newPort)
   305→				if launchErr != nil {
   306→					req.doneCh <- launchErr
   307→					break monitor
   308→				}
   309→
   310→				ps.mu.Lock()
   311→				ps.proc = newCmd.Process
   312→				ps.mu.Unlock()
   313→
   314→				if healthErr := waitHealthy(ctx, newPort, 120*time.Second); healthErr != nil {
   315→					newCmd.Process.Kill() //nolint:errcheck
   316→					newCmd.Wait()         //nolint:errcheck
   317→					ps.mu.Lock()
   318→					ps.proc = nil
   319→					ps.mu.Unlock()
   320→					req.doneCh <- healthErr
   321→					break monitor
   322→				}
   323→
   324→				ps.mu.Lock()
   325→				ps.healthy = true
   326→				ps.mu.Unlock()
   327→				m.log.Info("swap complete", "backend", name, "port", newPort, "model", req.model)
   328→				req.doneCh <- nil
   329→
   330→				cmd = newCmd
   331→				exitCh = make(chan error, 1)
   332→				go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
   333→
   334→			case exitErr := <-exitCh:
   335→				ps.mu.Lock()
   336→				ps.healthy = false
   337→				ps.proc = nil
   338→				ps.mu.Unlock()
   339→
   340→				if ctx.Err() != nil {
   341→					return
   342→				}
   343→
   344→				if exitErr != nil {
   345→					if ee, ok := errors.AsType[*exec.ExitError](exitErr); ok {
   346→						m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "backend", name, "exit_code", ee.ExitCode())
   347→					} else {
   348→						m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "backend", name, "error", exitErr)
   349→					}
   350→				}
   351→				break monitor
   352→			}
   353→		}
   354→		// Fall through to retry.
   355→	}
   356→}

   358→// launch starts a llama-server process and wires its stdout/stderr to slog.
   359→func (m *Manager) launch(ctx context.Context, name string, b config.Backend, port int) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
   360→	cmd := m.cmdBuilder(ctx, b, port)
   361→
   362→	cmd.Cancel = func() error {
   363→		if cmd.Process == nil {
   364→			return nil
   365→		}
   366→		return cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM)
   367→	}
   368→	cmd.WaitDelay = 10 * time.Second
   369→
   370→	cmd.Stdout = &lineLogger{log: m.log, name: name}
   371→	cmd.Stderr = &lineLogger{log: m.log, name: name}
   372→
   373→	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
   374→		return nil, err
   375→	}
   376→	return cmd, nil
   377→}
   378→
   379→// lineLogger buffers subprocess output and emits each complete line as a slog
   380→// debug record. It is called from cmd's internal I/O goroutine — no locking needed.
   381→type lineLogger struct {
   382→	log  *slog.Logger
   383→	name string
   384→	buf  bytes.Buffer
   385→}
   386→
   387→func (l *lineLogger) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
   388→	l.buf.Write(p)
   389→	for {
   390→		b := l.buf.Bytes()
   391→		idx := bytes.IndexByte(b, '\n')
   392→		if idx < 0 {
   393→			break
   394→		}
   395→		line := string(b[:idx])
   396→		l.buf.Next(idx + 1)
   397→		if len(line) > 0 {
   398→			l.log.Debug(line, "backend", l.name)
   399→		}
   400→	}
   401→	return len(p), nil
   402→}
   403→
   404→// buildArgs constructs the llama-server command-line arguments from a Backend config.
   405→func buildArgs(b config.Backend, port int) []string {
   406→	args := []string{
   407→		"-hf", b.Model,
   408→		"--port", strconv.Itoa(port),
   409→		"--no-webui",
   410→	}
   411→	if b.GPULayers > 0 {
   412→		args = append(args, "-ngl", strconv.Itoa(b.GPULayers))
   413→	}
   414→	if b.Context > 0 {
   415→		args = append(args, "-c", strconv.Itoa(b.Context))
   416→	}
   417→	if b.Pooling != "" {
   418→		args = append(args, "--embedding", "--pooling", b.Pooling)
   419→	}
   420→	return append(args, b.Extra...)
   421→}
   422→
   423→// freePort finds a free TCP port by binding to :0 and immediately releasing it.
   424→func freePort() (int, error) {
   425→	l, err := net.Listen("tcp", ":0")
   426→	if err != nil {
   427→		return 0, err
   428→	}
   429→	port := l.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
   430→	l.Close()
   431→	return port, nil
   432→}
   433→
   434→// waitHealthy polls GET /health on the given port every second until it
   435→// returns 200 OK, the context is cancelled, or the timeout elapses.
   436→func waitHealthy(ctx context.Context, port int, timeout time.Duration) error {
   437→	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
   438→	defer cancel()
   439→
   440→	url := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d/health", port)
   441→	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
   442→	ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
   443→	defer ticker.Stop()
   444→
   445→	for {
   446→		select {
   447→		case <-ctx.Done():
   448→			return ctx.Err()
   449→		case <-ticker.C:
   450→			resp, err := client.Get(url) //nolint:noctx
   451→			if err == nil {
   452→				resp.Body.Close()
   453→				if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
   454→					return nil
   455→				}
   456→			}
   457→		}
   458→	}
   459→}

    20→// backendManager is the subset of process.Manager the Gateway depends on.
    21→type backendManager interface {
    22→	Addr(name string) (string, bool)
    23→	Healthy(name string) bool
    24→}
    25→
    26→// Gateway is an HTTP reverse-proxy that routes OpenAI-compatible requests to backends.
    27→type Gateway struct {
    28→	cfg    *config.Config
    29→	mgr    backendManager
    30→	log    *slog.Logger
    31→	rt     *routeTable
    32→	server *http.Server
    33→}
    34→
    35→// New creates a Gateway backed by the given process manager.
    36→func New(cfg *config.Config, mgr *process.Manager, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
    37→	return newGateway(cfg, mgr, log)
    38→}
    39→
    40→func newGateway(cfg *config.Config, mgr backendManager, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
    41→	g := &Gateway{cfg: cfg, mgr: mgr, log: log, rt: buildRouteTable(cfg)}
    42→
    43→	mux := http.NewServeMux()
    44→	mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/chat/completions", g.handleRoute)
    45→	mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/completions", g.handleRoute)
    46→	mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/embeddings", g.handleRoute)
    47→	mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/rerank", g.handleRoute)
    48→	mux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/models", g.handleModels)
    49→	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health", g.handleHealth)
    50→
    51→	g.server = &http.Server{Addr: cfg.Listen, Handler: mux}
    52→	return g
    53→}
    54→
    55→// ListenAndServe starts the HTTP server and shuts it down when ctx is cancelled.
    56→func (g *Gateway) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context) error {
    57→	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
    58→	go func() {
    59→		if err := g.server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
    60→			errCh <- err
    61→		}
    62→	}()
    63→	select {
    64→	case err := <-errCh:
    65→		return err
    66→	case <-ctx.Done():
    67→		shutCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
    68→		defer cancel()
    69→		return g.server.Shutdown(shutCtx)
    70→	}
    71→}
    72→
    73→// handleRoute extracts the model field from the JSON body and proxies to the matching backend.
    74→func (g *Gateway) handleRoute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    75→	if len(g.cfg.Backends) == 0 {
    76→		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "no backends configured", "no_backends")
    77→		return
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// Tee the body so the decoder and the upstream both see it.
    81→	var captured bytes.Buffer
    82→	tee := io.TeeReader(r.Body, &captured)
    83→	dec := json.NewDecoder(tee)
    84→
    85→	var payload struct {
    86→		Model string `json:"model"`
    87→	}
    88→	if err := dec.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
    89→		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "invalid JSON: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
    90→		return
    91→	}
    92→	if payload.Model == "" {
    93→		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "missing model field", "bad_request")
    94→		return
    95→	}
    96→
    97→	// Reconstruct full body: captured bytes (read by decoder) + rest not yet read.
    98→	r.Body = io.NopCloser(io.MultiReader(&captured, r.Body))

   265→func (rr *replacingReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
